candidates.why: created_by is a static that is freed at 4305 and NULLed at 4306 only on the normal exit path of dwg_read_json. It is never reset at function entry (4106-4124), and the early-return paths (4225-4226, 4232-4233, 4242-4243, 4289-4290, 4295-4296) return without freeing/NULLing it. A later call can therefore reach json_created_by line 828/830 with a stale pointer, or reach 4305 and free a pointer left over from a previous call — a cross-call use-after-free/double-free of the static.

If the JSON contains the "created_by" key twice, line 828 overwrites the static created_by with a new json_string allocation without freeing the previous one; the earlier block becomes unreachable and is leaked, and the pointer freed at 4305 no longer refers to it. Suspicious lifetime handling of the static across repeated assignments.
